# What the workload-microsandbox service is made of. A push to main that changes
# any of it rebuilds the service's image and redeploys it, and nothing else does,
# because every redeploy restarts every microVM task the service runs.
#
# Code the service shares with everything else (the domain, configuration,
# telemetry, certificates) is not listed: it reaches the service with the next
# change that is. That is safe because the API is versioned, so orchestrators and
# the service need not be built from one commit. The orchestrator's client
# (infrastructure/workload/microsandbox/client) ships in the orchestrator's
# image, so it is excluded too.
#
# One entry per line, read by .github/workflows/workload-microsandbox.yaml:
#   - a git pathspec: a file, a directory ending in /, or :(exclude) one;
#   - or a file and a text after it, which counts only when a changed line of
#     that file contains the text.

# the contract, the service, its SDK adapter, configuration and command
infrastructure/workload/microsandbox/
:(exclude)infrastructure/workload/microsandbox/client/
application/workload/microsandbox/
presentation/http/workload/microsandbox/
presentation/commands/workload/microsandbox/
infrastructure/configs/microsandbox.go
infrastructure/ioc/providers/workload/microsandbox.go
infrastructure/ioc/providers/workload/microsandbox_sdk.go
commands_microsandbox.go

# its image and its deployment. The Dockerfile holds every image, so a change to
# any of them redeploys this one as well.
Dockerfile
compose.workload-microsandbox.yaml

# the SDK's version, which the image's microsandbox has to equal
go.mod github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/
